title: Beyond a Single Direction: Chain-of-Thought Disrupts Simple Steering of Refusal
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic representation and control of refusal in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) via activation steering and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) manipulation. Although it notes the presence or absence of 'ethical justifications' in generated CoT traces during qualitative analysis, it is a technical study of model safety mechanisms rather than an evaluation or benchmark of ethical, moral, or religious systems.
